items.reason: Gap 0 describes a second delivery arriving while the first is still running, so both pass the check before the id is recorded and the handler runs twice.
Gap 2 says the key comes from the unsigned X-Event-Id header and that a validly signed body with a fresh header value bypasses deduplication.
Gap 3 says the provider sends charge.refunded while the refund handler is registered as refund.created, so real refunds have no handler.
No gap depends on several processes or instances; gap 1 concerns a single process restarting.
